stories.title: Create Support Ticket
stories.story: As a user, I want to create support tickets from both web and mobile applications, so that I can get assistance for my issues easily.
acceptance_criteria: Users can create tickets using both web and mobile interfaces.
A unique ticket ID is generated automatically upon ticket creation.
The system must validate the input fields before submission.

stories.title: Assign Tickets to Teams
stories.story: As a support agent, I want to assign tickets to different teams based on category, so that the tickets can be handled by the appropriate experts.
acceptance_criteria: Support agents can categorize tickets into Billing, Technical, or General Inquiry.
Agents can change the assigned team at any point before ticket resolution.

stories.title: Manage Ticket Status
stories.story: As a support agent, I want to update the status of support tickets, so that users and agents can track the progress.
acceptance_criteria: Each ticket can be updated to one of the following statuses: Open, In Progress, Waiting for Customer, Resolved, Closed.
Users can view the current status of their tickets anytime.

stories.title: View Ticket History
stories.story: As a user, I want to view the ticket history along with all previous comments, so that I can understand the progress and provide additional information if needed.
acceptance_criteria: Users can access their ticket history from their account dashboard.
Each ticket displays all previous comments and status changes chronologically.

stories.title: Email Notifications for Events
stories.story: As a user, I want to receive email notifications for ticket creation, status updates, and resolution, so that I can stay informed about my support tickets.
acceptance_criteria: Users receive an email confirmation upon ticket creation.
Users receive an email whenever the status of their ticket changes.
Users receive an email notification when their ticket is resolved.

stories.title: SLA Tracking
stories.story: As a support manager, I want the system to track SLA response times for tickets, so that we can ensure we meet our service commitments.
acceptance_criteria: The system must categorize tickets based on their priorities: High, Medium, and Low.
Response time metrics are tracked: 4 hours for High, 24 hours for Medium, and 72 hours for Low priority tickets.

stories.title: Export Tickets for Reporting
stories.story: As a support manager, I want to export tickets in CSV format, so that I can generate reports for analysis.
acceptance_criteria: A functionality exists to export all tickets in CSV format.
The exported file includes relevant ticket details (ID, status, date created, etc.).

stories.title: Support Manager Dashboard
stories.story: As a support manager, I want a dashboard that displays ticket data metrics, so that I can monitor team performance and ticket status.
acceptance_criteria: The dashboard should display the total number of tickets, the count of open vs closed tickets, and the average resolution time.
Data should be updated in real-time.

stories.title: User Authentication
stories.story: As a user, I want to log in using my email and password, so that I can securely access my account.
acceptance_criteria: Users can log in using their registered email and password.
The system must include validation for incorrect login credentials.

stories.title: Performance Support
stories.story: As a system administrator, I want the system to support handling at least 10,000 tickets per day, so that we can manage high volume efficiently.
acceptance_criteria: The system is tested and confirmed to handle at least 10,000 ticket submissions per day without degradation of performance.

stories.title: Implement Role-Based Access Control
stories.story: As a security administrator, I want to enforce security and role-based access control, so that sensitive information is protected.
acceptance_criteria: Users are assigned roles (e.g., user, support agent, manager) with specific permissions.
Access to certain functionalities is restricted according to the user's role.

stories.title: Mobile Application Development
stories.story: As a product manager, I want to prioritize the mobile application in Phase 1, so that users can create and manage tickets on the go.
acceptance_criteria: The mobile application is built and tested for both iOS and Android platforms.
Users should be able to create, view, and update tickets via the mobile application.
